identityStatus: Exact Q546122 node 826383904 with A0098 and height 49. Derek Harper subject coordinate -4.26798,50.18378 is approximately 5.5 m away. Operator navigation-review table conflicts by roughly 380 m and is retained as an unresolved source discrepancy.
axis: +Y up; +Z entrance/hoist faces reconstructed south-southwest quadrant, approximately 202 degrees true, +/-25 degrees. The circular tower has no main plan axis.
geometryLabel: Reconstructed 2012 entrance-facing view-direction ray; not a surveyed footprint or exact boat position

cameraControl.basis: Photographer states view NNE about 22 degrees; inspected image shows the entrance-facing window/door rank nearly frontal. Its coarse subject/camera points conflict with the newer mapped tower, so only the reported view quadrant is used, not its coordinates.

positionControl.basis: Use the exact-QID map position for viewer alignment, with the 2024 photographer subject location as corroboration. The 2025-30 operator review table repeats a conflicting older latitude; no datum transform or cartographic error is asserted as proven.

waterControl.basis: Visible modeled base meets the host sea-level review plane. This is a visual datum convention, not surveyed reef elevation, mean-high-water conversion, tide or bathymetry.

limits: Mapped viewer anchor is preferred for map alignment; operator table discrepancy remains unresolved and is not silently labelled survey truth. Door/hoist azimuth is a photo-quadrant reconstruction +/-25 degrees. Old Smeaton stump and reef are not part of this single-tower asset. No surveyed footprint, exact landing orientation, present tide or submerged foundation is claimed.
